newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka loses at close on dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka loses at close on dlr demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 43.7475/7495 to the dollar in interbank trading on Tuesday against previous close at 43.7450/7490.
The taka opened at Monday's level but slipped on dollar requirement of major state-owned banks, dealers said.
"There was shortfall in dollar. Some banks might have turned to the central bank for their requirement," said ond dealer.
The interbank call money rates closed at five to six percent, down from Monday's six to 6.5 percent, dealers said.
